brief: 6 keyboard-first apps that quietly replaced my mouse.

slots.subline: essential utilities for keyboard power users

slots.heroTitle: The blazing fast launcher for Mac
slots.heroBody: Replace Spotlight with a command-line style launcher that opens apps, runs scripts, and manages windows entirely from your keyboard.
slots.slideSubtitle: A command palette for apps, scripts, and system control without ever pointing.

slots.heroTitle: Snap windows with your keyboard instantly
slots.heroBody: Organize your desktop using hotkeys that resize and position windows into perfect tiles in milliseconds.
slots.slideSubtitle: Ditch drag-and-drop window management for instant keyboard-driven snapping across any Mac display.

slots.heroTitle: Browse the web without touching your mouse
slots.heroBody: Navigate links, scroll pages, and manage tabs using Vim-inspired shortcuts directly inside your browser.
slots.slideSubtitle: Turn Chrome or Firefox into a keyboard-first experience where every link is a shortcut away.

slots.heroTitle: The issue tracker built for speed
slots.heroBody: Fly through tasks, create issues, and triage bugs using powerful shortcuts designed for developer workflows.
slots.slideSubtitle: Linear keeps your hands on the keyboard from ticket creation to sprint completion every day.

slots.heroTitle: A markdown powerhouse driven by hotkeys
slots.heroBody: Link notes, toggle panes, and search your vault using customizable shortcuts that keep you writing.
slots.slideSubtitle: Build a personal knowledge base without ever breaking flow to reach for your pointer.

slots.heroTitle: Click anything on screen with keystrokes
slots.heroBody: Assign keyboard shortcuts to every clickable button, menu, and link so your mouse stays hidden.
slots.slideSubtitle: Homerow overlays labels onto UI elements, letting you click precisely without moving your cursor.

slots.eyebrow: the rest is up to you
slots.sublineItalic: Pick one tool, master its shortcuts, and reclaim the seconds you spend reaching for the cursor.
